The '''Chicken Mask''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|2000}} after earning the "A Big Help" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (complete 40 [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|'Help Wanted']] requests).

==Trivia==
* This hat could be a reference to [[wikipedia:Space Quest III|Space Quest III: The Pirates of Pestulon]]. In it, the player can purchase a hat called the Official Astro Chicken Flight Hat, and is told "you'll really turn some heads in this sporty little number!"
